statePreservation: Existing identities, vocabulary, references, commitments, capabilities and physical resources remain authoritative. Only fresh isolated worlds were used; baseline build files were read without opening its world. Concurrent unrelated workspace edits were preserved.
limits: Finite authored meanings/constructions; supported first use is not invention of a new category
Shared regional dialects with individual voices/learned words; no assertion of unrelated unique languages for every actor
Timed grunts render symbolic speech; no waveform ASR, reversible phonetic codec or client auditory quality result
Staged cohorts and controlled native opportunities are not biological reproduction, natural social rates or survival evidence
No population-scale compute/audio benchmark or artificial-life equivalence claim
